scope: Read-only review of the private CPU P3 source candidate and future time-step policy; no public switch, build, solver or physical acceptance is certified by this note.
candidate_identity: The three-file review below binds the preserved r1 snapshot audited at the stated UTC, not the subsequently edited working tree. The r2 wrapper-only correction is identified separately below.

candidate_review.mathematics: w=Vj*d dot ((Ci+Cj)*gradW)/(r2+Eta2) equals 2*Vj*beta_sym. Gp=-sum(Vj*dp*Ci*gradW). The helper assigns (Kw/ni)*[-theta+k/gamma*(Lpair-Gp dot Lx+rho_w*div_receiverC(Ace))] once.
candidate_review.stage_order: Native C computed, then owner-ID C extension before fused force. After all admitted stage forces: extend native Ace/theta, compute normal-fluid rates, extend native rate to periodic clones, release map, then AceMax.
candidate_review.periodic_and_omp: One extra 4-byte pool slot is sufficient for the non-overlapping maps. Parallel rate writes are receiver-local; invalid count is reduced and map freed before the final exception. Copied theta prevents incomplete clone neighborhoods corrupting clone J integration.
candidate_review.restrictions: Fresh no-wall elastic CPU fixtures only. No general boundary, exclusion, restart or GPU admission. CalcRidp assumes unique normal IDs; fixtures must verify native identity and no exclusion.
candidate_review.wrapper_zeroing_r1_r2: The audited r1 snapshot has unconditional if(t.porepressrate) memset at JSphCpu.cpp:2893. Root subsequently changed only that wrapper condition to if(t.porepressrate && !DynamicPorePressure), which preserves OFF clearing and allows ON overwrite-sentinel testing. The corrected r2 source snapshot is separately bound below; this note does not certify its fresh-build regression.
candidate_review.off_and_k0: Default flag is false and legacy numeric expressions are unchanged. Runtime OFF equivalence belongs to separately sealed receipts. New k=0 sum(theta)-then-multiply can round differently from old per-neighbor multiplication; test its declared reference rather than promise bitwise identity.

current_time_step.sound_speed: JSph.cpp:3755 ConfigConstantsSoil sets Cs0=sqrt((K+4G/3)/RhopZero): skeleton constrained longitudinal speed, not undrained coupled speed. Cs0 also enters EOS constants and artificial viscosity, so globally replacing it would alter old behavior beyond time stepping.
current_time_step.cpu_gpu: JSphCpu.cpp:4663 and JSphGpu.cpp:1568 use dt1=sqrt(h/AceMax), dt2=h/(max(Cs0,10*VelMax)+h*ViscDtMax), dt_mech=CFL*min(dt1,dt2). Their diffusion estimate is PoreDtSafety*n0*rho_w*g_ref*h^2/(Kw*k), with g_ref=|Gravity| or 9.80665 when physical gravity is zero.
current_time_step.same_stage_state_required: New-mode scales should use ni=1-(1-n0)/Ji, Vi=V0*Ji and rho_ti=rho_w+(rho0-rho_w)/Ji: cu_max=max_i sqrt((K+4G/3+Kw/ni)/rho_ti), Dmax=max_i Kw*k/(ni*gamma). Scan native physical particles, not periodic copies or passive Velrhop.w. Current h is fixed.
current_time_step.first_step: ConfigConstants2 at JSph.cpp:1673-1674 can fill default DtIni/DtMin before ConfigConstantsSoil; its later !DtIni checks then do not recompute them. InitRun at 2347 assigns SymplecticDtPre=DtIni. ComputeStep_Sym at JSphCpuSingle.cpp:949 locks used dt before both DtVariable calls; those calls choose the NEXT step. Editing DtVariable alone cannot protect an oversized first/current step.
current_time_step.fixed_step: FixedDt overrides dt_mech and bypasses dtw in both backends. JDsFixedDt::GetDt at 103 returns the configured value/interpolation and records max(fixed-dtvar); it never clips. Current dterror therefore does not prove even the old hydraulic bound, let alone the new coupled bound.
current_time_step.minimum_step: CPU:4682 and GPU:1588 raise a selected dt below DtMin. In new mode an incompatible DtMin must be rejected, not allowed to raise dt above the audited limit.
current_time_step.operator_limit: Lstar is receiver-dependent and nonconservative; corrected coefficients and div(Ace) feedback are absent from the old scalar diffusion estimate. Frozen pressure-only Dirichlet spectra do not include acceleration dependence on pressure/stress, changing J/C or coupled time-integration amplification. The old 2D/3D safety value is not a proved new-operator limit.

bounded_linear_diagnostic_not_a_new_gate.assumptions: Uniform frozen 1D elastic state and continuum spatial derivatives; M=K+4G/3, B=Kw/n, D=B*k/gamma, r=rho_w/rho_t, wave number kappa.
bounded_linear_diagnostic_not_a_new_gate.current_wave_example: M=B=268435456 Pa, rho_t=2048, rho_w=1000, kappa=2*pi/.125: cd=362.038672 m/s, cu=512 m/s; continuum roots approximately -39.804566 +/-25730.545072i and -3459.469673 per second. This is a derived diagnostic, not a discrete or physical acceptance receipt.

next_minimal_work_after_current_tests: Use the corrected r2 wrapper only with fresh builds/labels for implementation gates after owned jobs seal; preserve rejected r1 and do not modify retained results.
Before public activation, add a new-mode-only native cu/D reduction and explicit initial/current-step checks. Preserve old OFF equations, Cs0, FixedDt and output-grid behavior.

For new mode form the complete natural candidate before FixedDt diagnostics. Reject an oversized fixed step or incompatible DtMin clearly; do not silently clip a fixed-grid run or add retry logic without a separate design.

Use bounded actual coupled periodic modes including a higher wave number and controlled J/n variation to evaluate complete discrete amplification, amplitude/phase and independent half steps. Pressure-only eigenchecks, D*dt/h^2 and short normal exit are not interchangeable proofs.
Only after those conclusions select/document new safety factors and public input/GPU policy. No TPI, general stability framework or threshold changes are authorized by this audit.
